title: Pietsch s-numbers and the maximal difference theorem
abstract: Formalizes the five classical s-number sequences, their comparison inequalities, the maximal difference theorem, compact-operator singular value decomposition, John ellipsoids, entropy numbers, and compactness characterizations.

informal.SNumbers.approximationNumber_le_e_mul_hi: For a bounded operator, its nth approximation number is at most e times (n+1) times its nth Hilbert number.
informal.SNumbers.allSNumbers_eq_on_HilbertSpace: Every s-number sequence agrees with the approximation numbers on operators between Hilbert spaces.
informal.John.john_decomposition: In John position, the identity decomposes into a positive weighted sum of rank-one operators from contact points.
